Department of the Treasury.title: CMS February 2024 Marketplace advance premium tax credit by state
Department of the Treasury.basis: A one-month operational Marketplace view, separate from the Treasury FY2024 cash total. Each amount is CMS's state APTC enrollment multiplied by its published average monthly APTC and rounded to the nearest dollar; the $10.346B row total differs slightly from the national product because CMS publishes state averages to cents.

Department of the Treasury.title: IRS tax-year 2023 net premium tax credit by adjusted gross income
Department of the Treasury.basis: IRS Statistics of Income estimates for tax year 2023 returns filed in 2024. Dollar amounts are published in thousands and converted to dollars. This tax-return view is separate from both CMS monthly advance payments and Treasury FY2024 cash outlays; it is not additive to either.

Department of the Treasury.title: IRS tax-year 2023 net EITC by state
Department of the Treasury.basis: IRS EITC Central reports rounded state totals for tax year 2023 returns processed in 2024. The published rows sum to $63.677B, consistent with IRS's approximately $64B national headline. This tax-return-year view is separate from the Treasury FY2024 cash outlay and is not additive to it.

This tax-return view is separate from the Treasury FY2024 cash outlay and is not additive to it.
